hook: Max Welling earned his PhD in 1998 at Utrecht University under Nobel laureate physicist Gerard t Hooft before moving into machine learning through postdoctoral positions at Caltech, University College London and the University of Toronto. In 2013 he and Diederik Kingma published Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes, introducing the variational autoencoder and a reparameterization trick that made it possible to train deep generative latent-variable models with backpropagation. He became a professor at the University of Amsterdam, where he directs the Amsterdam Machine Learning Lab, and in 2016 he and Thomas Kipf published Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks, extending convolutional architectures to graph-structured data. He has also held research leadership roles at Microsoft Research and Qualcomm.
name: Max Welling
moniker: Co-inventor of the variational autoencoder and graph convolutional network

reading.body:
Max Welling's two most-cited contributions, the variational autoencoder (2013) and the graph convolutional network (2016), established core techniques for training generative models and learning on non-Euclidean data that remain foundational to modern AI systems.

The variational autoencoder introduced a practical method to train deep generative models by making the reparameterization trick compatible with backpropagation. This solved a concrete engineering problem: how to train latent-variable models at scale. Graph convolutional networks extended this capability to structured data like molecular graphs and citation networks, addressing the challenge of applying convolutional principles beyond regular grids. Both papers remain widely cited and extended because they answered structural questions about what architectures could be trained efficiently.

These contributions sit upstream of compute-intensive applications. Generative models and graph networks now form part of the standard toolkit for scaling language models, molecular simulation, and reasoning systems. They are techniques that, once proven trainable, enable downstream systems to use larger models and more complex data structures. However, this data covers scientific contribution, not deployment scale or power consumption. It does not reveal how much compute these methods require in practice, or how their adoption has affected total AI power demand.

Welling's career path, from theoretical physics through postdoctoral positions to academic leadership, reflects the common trajectory of foundational ML research: sustained work in university settings with selective industry research roles, rather than full-time involvement in the companies that operationalize these techniques at scale.

achievements.title: Variational Autoencoder (VAE)
achievements.impact: Introduced a reparameterization technique that made deep latent-variable generative models trainable with standard backpropagation, becoming a foundational architecture for generative modeling and representation learning.

achievements.title: Graph Convolutional Network (GCN)
achievements.impact: Extended convolutional network principles to graph-structured data, enabling scalable semi-supervised learning on citation networks, knowledge graphs and molecular graphs.

achievements.title: Amsterdam Machine Learning Lab
achievements.impact: Built one of Europe's leading academic machine learning research groups, producing influential work in generative modeling and geometric deep learning.
